verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm an llms.txt at arize.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and Phoenix docs pages are served as Markdown (phoenix.md) with a pointer to a full documentation-index llms.txt. The docs also include agent-directed setup guidance ("Let your coding agent set up tracing for you" via the phoenix-cli setup command). Missing for 10: a Phoenix-specific llms.txt (the root one is Arize-wide), and first-party documentation or independent corroboration of how well agents consume these docs.
